"When is 'next time'?" Shen Yuan glared at her viciously, as if looking at an enemy.

"I don't know," Si Rong said lightly.

Feeling that she was being brushed off, Shen Yuan immediately burst into bitter tears.

"Alright, alright," Mother Shen pulled her granddaughter into her arms. "Si Rong, you're unbelievable! If the child wants something, just buy it! What are you making her cry for in the middle of the night?"

"Mom, I can't buy that item. If you want it bought, you buy it for her!"

Si Rong said with a trace of speechlessness.

She just wanted to go back to her bedroom and have some peace and quiet.

"I'll buy it then!" Mother Shen said in a shrill voice.

Si Rong gave a silent, cold laugh. Glancing back at the grandmother and granddaughter hugging each other, she suddenly felt that Shen Yuan's features looked a lot like Mother Shen's.

A thought suddenly sparked like a tiny flame deep in her heart.

Back in her room, Si Rong felt her own idea was far too shocking.

Shen Lan had explicitly claimed those two children were adopted from an orphanage.

With tragic backgrounds.

Si Rong leaned against the head of the bed and suddenly chuckled, laughing at how terribly foolish she had been to still believe Shen Lan's words up until now?

Good heavens, what kind of man had she been sleeping next to all these years?

Fooled her for so many years; even wolves and tigers wouldn't be as vicious as him.

So much time had passed; she had forgotten all about the details of those two children's origins, but looking at it now, there was clearly something deeply suspicious about it.

In the past, everyone said Shen Lan loved her, said she had great fortune, and even she herself had believed it.

Footsteps sounded outside the door, followed by the door being pushed open; Shen Lan had come home from work.

chapters.title: Shen Yun Goes on a Blind Date
chapters.content:
The man took off his coat and laughed, "Is Rongrong in a bad mood? Why did you make that little girl cry as soon as you got back?"

He had inherited Madam Shen's good looks, and a pair of peach-blossom eyes that looked deeply affectionate when he smiled.

When he walked to the bedside, he gave Si Rong a gentle hug, just as he always did.

Si Rong, who used to find the gesture sweet, now only felt nauseated.

This man was truly a good actor. With a mistress out there, he could still put on such a loving act in front of her; it was a waste that he wasn't an actor.

She smiled faintly and pushed him away, "Second Brother is so busy he doesn't even have time to sleep. We can talk about it next time."

"Besides, children can be loved, but not spoiled. How could I, as her mother, possibly want to harm her?"

Seeing Si Rong say this, Shen Lan immediately replied, "How could that be? Xiao Yuan wouldn't think that way. I'll have a good talk with her later, don't be upset."

Seeming truly worried that Si Rong was angry, Shen Lan changed the subject, "By the way, is Mingzi in a better mood?"

Si Rong nodded.

"Naturally, with my wife to accompany her, of course her mood would improve. It's just a pity for me," Shen Lan said pitifully. Seeing Si Rong didn't take the bait, he continued, "Is it still about her husband and other women?"

Si Rong suddenly smiled, her apricot-shaped eyes staring at the expression on Shen Lan's face, "That's right, Luo Sheng is keeping another woman outside. What about you? I'm getting older now, will you keep a woman outside?"

"Of course not," there was not a trace of guilt on Shen Lan's face; not a single flaw could be found in his micro-expressions, "Rongrong, having you as my only woman in this lifetime is enough. Out of a thousand blossoms, I only want you."

"Is that so?" Si Rong's five fingers gently stroked his cheek, "Then what if one day, I catch you with another woman? What will happen?"

"I'll let you dispose of me however you like."

Shen Lan spread his hands flat and lay down on the bed, looking entirely loyal to her.

"I once read a story where the male lead promised the female lead he would only love her alone for a lifetime. Later, the male lead's heart changed, and the female lead dug out his heart."

She smiled brightly, gazing at Shen Lan with the same gentleness as before.

Shen Lan looked back at her affectionately, "If that day really comes, you won't even need to do it yourself. I will dig out my heart with my own hands and present it to you."

Hearing his sincere and touching sweet words now, Si Rong suddenly understood why she had been hoodwinked for so many years.

With acting skills worthy of a Best Actor, even lies sounded pleasant and melodious when spoken by him.

"If that day really comes, I don't want your heart." Even if she shut herself off from the outside world, Si Rong knew reality was different from novels; digging out someone else's heart was punishable by law. "I want you to go back to the past, back to when you had nothing."

As soon as these words came out, Si Rong noticed Shen Lan's eyelashes tremble slightly.

She couldn't help but curve her lips into a smile.

Her slender fingers gently stroked his handsome brows and eyes, "Don't be afraid, you wouldn't betray me, right?"

Shen Lan practically blurted out his answer, "Right, I won't. Never."

The room was quiet for a good while, and outside, Shen Yuan had also stopped making a fuss.

After another moment, Shen Lan lightly draped one arm around her waist, "I heard Mom say you introduced another blind date for Xiaoyun? Wife, you've really had it hard."

"It's not hard," Si Rong glanced at him sideways, "We're all family. If we're talking about who has it hard, it's you who have it harder, running around outside every day."

Running around dallying with her good friend.

"The man introduced this time is quite good. He's a newly recruited section chief at the Health Bureau this year. He's talented and handsome; Xiaoyun will definitely like him when she sees him."

"A section chief," Shen Lan thought of when he had just married Si Rong; he was just a minor section chief himself.

Heroes are not judged by their origins, and over the years, through his own ability, he had already risen to the position of deputy county magistrate.

A man has nothing to fear as long as he has drive.

Taking a step back, if this little section chief really became his brother-in-law, he could promote him in the future.

Because Madam Shen and Shen Yun were there, Shen Yuan had to give up her room and sleep between them.

Although Shen Yuan had perfunctorily apologized to Si Rong with her lips, when sleeping, she turned her back to her and hugged Shen Lan to sleep.

Si Rong wasn't angry in her heart. Since she had already made up her mind, she wouldn't let these people affect her emotions anymore.

It was just impossible to say she wasn't hurt at all in her heart.

They say people's hearts are exchanged with hearts, but she, a person who had never been a mother before, had learned bit by bit how to be a mother for the sake of these two little ones.

Apart from her, who could possibly understand the bitterness of that struggle?

Si Rong turned over, turning her back to the father and daughter.

The next day, after the father and daughter got up, she found a long hair and a short hair on the pillow, then put them into her pocket.

"Si Rong! Xiaoyun is going on a blind date later, hurry up and help her dress up!"

Madam Shen commanded in a bossy tone.

In the past, Si Rong had indeed very carefully helped Shen Yun dress up. Good clothes, jewelry, and the like; once Shen Yun wore them, she never returned them.

But from now on, she could forget about all these things.

She only let Shen Yun wash her face clean, and no matter how much Madam Shen hinted, she had no intention of going into the room to get her own jewelry for Shen Yun to wear.

Madam Shen couldn't pick a fight openly either; she knew she was still counting on Si Rong for her daughter's blind date today.

However, thinking about how Si Rong was being kept completely in the dark by her son, she wasn't as angry anymore.

Served her right!

Madam Shen demanded that Si Rong accompany her daughter on the blind date. Although this daughter-in-law had no redeeming qualities, she at least had a good family background and had seen the big world; it would be safer to have her accompany the daughter.

Seeing the two of them standing together, Madam Shen couldn't help but feel annoyed to the point of frustration.

Although she had dressed her daughter up over and over again, standing next to her daughter-in-law, who was dressed in simple clothes, she was contrasted to look more and more like a nouveau riche.

The saying "clothes make the man" didn't seem very persuasive anymore.

She also bore some responsibility for her daughter not being good-looking. If she could have inherited the good points of herself and her old man just like Lan'er, how could she have reached this age without getting married?

Si Rong led Shen Yun all the way to the park where they were supposed to meet the blind date.

The man they were meeting this time was named Yang Junwei.

His face was indeed quite handsome, and as soon as she saw him, Shen Yun lowered her head shyly.

Si Rong knew she had taken a fancy to him.

Yang Junwei's gaze lingered on Si Rong's face for quite a while. Originally, he had come with the intention of advancing his career, but he hadn't expected her to be so pretty.

The tip of his heart fluttered a few times.

He was the first to reach out his hand to Si Rong, "Hello, Comrade Shen, right? I'm your blind date, Yang Junwei!"

Shen Yun, standing aside: ……

---

chapters.title: She Also Has a Husband-Prospering Fate
chapters.content:
As soon as she got home, she was going to tell her brother that Si Rong was restless!

In broad daylight, she was actually directly flirting with her blind date!

It was simply too outrageous!

"Comrade, I am Shen Yun."

She rubbed her braids with some embarrassment, and then took the initiative to clasp Yang Junwei's strong palm.

Yang Junwei: ……

The hanging heart finally died after all.

He just knew it; marrying a wife was like buying things; cheap goods are no good.

When the matchmaker said the female side had an elder brother who was a deputy county magistrate, that the sister-in-law's family was the newly rich Si family of Huaiyang, and that she was unmarried at thirty-five, he had already made a rapid assessment in his mind.

At best, she was as ugly as Wu Yan; at worst, she was disabled.

Just now, when he saw someone rather pretty, he even felt it wasn't real. Very good, feeling the chubby hand in his grip, he finally felt it was real.

"Hello, I am Shen Yun's sister-in-law, Si Rong."

Si Rong hadn't expected this person to mistake the blind date either; it seemed his brain wasn't very sharp.

Most importantly, he looked full of calculation.

Yet Shen Yun was as pleased as could be, thinking that in her thirty-fifth year, she had finally met her Prince Charming.

"Sister-in-law, don't you still have things to take care of?" Shen Yun didn't want Si Rong staying behind to get in the way, so she hurriedly said.

Si Rong raised an eyebrow. This sister-in-law of hers used all her cleverness on eating; setting her sights on a man like this meant she would only be as unlucky as her in the future.

"Alright then, you and Mr. Yang have a good chat."

After Si Rong left, she went to Mingzi's house.

"I've been waiting for you," Mingzi had already applied light makeup.

"I just accompanied my sister-in-law on a blind date. Later, the two of us are going to the city."

Mingzi had a car at home and also a driver's license.

"Okay," Mingzi didn't even ask what they were going for. While changing into her slippers, she fished out the car keys.

Si Rong sat in the front passenger seat, "Let's go straight to the city hospital, I want to confirm something."

Whether there was a blood relation between Shen Yuan and Shen Lan.

Shen Chi and Shen Yuan were the same age, seventeen this year.

Her marriage to Shen Lan had lasted eighteen years. If Shen Yuan was Shen Lan's biological daughter, then Sun Qiang's deduction that those two adulterers had been together for five years would be wrong.

Could it be eighteen years instead?

She used a tremendous amount of force to control her body from trembling.

"I suspect Shen Yuan is Shen Lan's biological daughter."

"What?" Mingzi slammed on the brakes, then slowly recalled the events of back then. Those two children were indeed brought home by Shen Lan.

For so many years, she had treated them as her own. She had even envied her good friend for finding such an outstanding man who was both a good husband and a good father.

Turns out he was just jade on the outside and rotten on the inside.

A hypocrite like this was even more detestable than scumbags like her husband who were blatantly obvious!

"So, you're planning to go to the city hospital for a paternity test?"

Mingzi restarted the car, "If it's true, I'll go slap those two cheap bastards to death myself!"

"Don't rush, we'll have plenty of opportunities in the future."

Arriving at the city hospital, Si Rong took the two hairs she had brought to the testing department and paid five hundred yuan.

Only city-level hospitals could do paternity tests at this time.

The price was naturally expensive. Now it was 1993, and five hundred yuan was enough for many families' living expenses for several months.

The two best friends strolled around the city mall, each buying a set of pretty autumn clothes, and then went to eat hot pot together.

Si Rong was starting to look forward to life after divorce.

It was all her own fault for being foolish in the past, pouring all of herself into a man.

"I've decided, I want to open a dance class."

"That's right!" Mingzi felt genuinely happy for her from the bottom of her heart when she saw this state of hers, "Back in school, our dance teacher liked you the most."

"And if you were still dancing now, would Li Xuan that little bitch have any share in the county's New Year gala every year?"

"But it's not too late now. As long as you're willing to return to the stage, I'll be your most loyal audience member."

She understood how much Si Rong loved dancing. Even though she hadn't been on stage these years, she was still very disciplined in her private life, and her posture was still the most perfect shape it had ever been.

"Azi, thank you."

Si Rong took her hand, "However, I still need your help."

"Money! People! Use whatever you want!" Mingzi said very magnanimously.

Even her children called Si Rong godmother. If Si Rong's two children proved useless in the future, she was prepared to have her own children provide for Si Rong in her old age.

Si Rong was extremely grateful that she had always had such a true friend by her side, "I do need money, and I need people too."

"When the time comes, the dance class will belong to both of us. My money was all used to buy a house, so you provide the storefront, I'll handle the decoration, and I'll take charge of the publicity! Once the dance class is up and running, we'll split the profits fifty-fifty straight down the middle!"

Moreover, with this dance class around, it would be easier for her to explain to Shen Lan where her money went.

Whether he believed it or not by then would be his own business.

"Alright!" Mingzi had been bored enough being a rich housewife at home anyway; this way, she would have something to do from now on.

Although her dance foundation wasn't as good as Si Rong or that little bitch Li Xuan, she had after all come from the dance club; teaching a few girls who were just starting to learn dance was a breeze for her.

After returning to Huaiyang, it was already dusk.

As soon as Si Rong pushed the door open, she saw Madam Shen's displeased expression, but she pretended not to see it.

She walked straight to the dining table and drank water from her own cup.

Madam Shen was so angry that smoke was almost coming out of her nostrils.

Was this Si Rong doing it on purpose?

Didn't she see she was angry?

Was this how a daughter-in-law should act?

Yet she didn't dare say anything either, because her daughter was currently extremely satisfied with this blind date, and that man was also her daughter-in-law's connection.

Her daughter was still counting on Si Rong to put in a good word for her in front of that man.

"Sister-in-law, you're back!"

Shen Yun said happily, "Oh right, Junwei treated me to lunch today, I think he really likes me."

"That's truly wonderful."

Si Rong smiled. Of course Yang Junwei liked her; he liked that she had an elder brother who was a deputy county magistrate, and that she could help his official career in the future.

"Sister-in-law, then could you urge his side later? I was thinking, why not get our business settled before the New Year!"

"Have you made up your mind?" Si Rong picked up the TV remote, turned on the television, and asked.

Shen Yun nodded repeatedly, "Mm, I've made up my mind. I won't marry anyone else!"

Although Yang Junwei was only a minor section chief right now, she firmly believed that marrying her would change everything.

For a long time, the people in their village had said that her brother's official career had been so smooth-sailing precisely because he married Si Rong, a woman with a husband-prospering fate.

She must have a husband-prospering fate too!

chapters.title: Starting a Business
chapters.content:
Once Yang Junwei married her, his official position would only get higher and higher. Yang Junwei would definitely treat her better than her brother treated Si Rong!

"Right! When you go to the Yang family, you must put in a good word for your younger sister," Mrs. Shen exhorted. "Your younger sister marrying well will be a help to you in the future!"

Si Rong sneered. "Based on her? What does she have to help my Si family?"

Is she richer than the Si family?

Or more powerful than the Si family?

The Si family hadn't even taken Shen Lan seriously when he was a deputy county magistrate, let alone the obscure Yang family?

Simply hilarious.

Mrs. Shen was instantly furious.

Her belly heaving in agitation.

"Once you married into our Shen family, you became a member of the Shen family. Don't go casually throwing the Si family around," Mrs. Shen said, glaring at her with profound dissatisfaction.

She didn't know what was wrong with this daughter-in-law. She used to be extremely deferential to her, but now she actually dared to talk back.

"Right, A-Lan is going to run for county magistrate in a short while. Your Si family should remember to pull some strings and make the necessary arrangements."

Come to think of it, with her son becoming county magistrate, Si Rong as the magistrate's wife would benefit the most.

What a bargain for this capitalist's daughter!

Si Rong quietly watched this stubborn old hag throw her weight around. The double standards were quite something.

Now that they needed the Si family's help, it was "your Si family" again.

At that moment, Shen Lan also came home from work.

Just in time to hear Si Rong say, "Rest assured! I will definitely have my family help Shen Lan. Only when he does well can our whole family do better."

Shen Lan felt thoroughly comforted inside.

A man strives for half a lifetime precisely out of the yearning to have backing readily available behind him whenever he needs it.

However, he still needed to find a way to keep Li Xuan from pushing too hard.

To be fair, Si Rong was a fine, virtuous helper at home.

Even after he became county magistrate, he wouldn't ruthlessly kick Si Rong aside as Li Xuan wished.

He was a man who attached great importance to affection and loyalty.

Even though Si Rong hadn't given birth to children for him, which in ancient times would belong to one of the seven grounds for divorce,

"Wife, I'm home!"

Shen Lan hung his coat on the coat rack and announced loudly.

But Si Rong didn't run over and throw herself into his arms as she used to do.

Shen Lan didn't think much of it, assuming Si Rong felt too shy with his mother and younger sister around.

However, with Si Rong's words, he knew that this election was in the bag for him.

The Si family still held considerable sway in Huaiyang City. Because they had served as a treasury for the Eighth Route Army during the War of Resistance, they enjoyed high prestige in Huaiyang.

Whether it was directors of finance or various other bureaus; those dignitaries ordinary people couldn't normally touch...

could easily help him secure the position of county magistrate.

That night, Shen Yuan still slept between them. Originally, Mrs. Shen wanted to go back because she was worried about Mr. Shen being alone in the old hometown, but Shen Yun had her mind on her newly matched prospective partner, so the mother and daughter prepared to stay a few more days.

"Mom, I forgive you," Shen Yuan hugged Si Rong's waist, putting on a very sensible act. "Let's wait until after the college entrance exam to go to the concert! I want a new set of denim overalls, okay?"

Si Rong fought hard to keep from sneering out loud.

Forgive?

She looked at Shen Yuan's facial features beside the pillow, and the more she looked, the more she felt they looked exactly like Shen Lan's.

When she first got married, she had fantasized countless times; fantasized that she would give birth to a child with features very similar to both of them.

Pity she was infertile.

But now, looking at this immature face that was five parts like Shen Lan, she only felt cold and disgusted.

What a fine tactical retreat: postponing the concert in order to turn around and have her buy clothes instead.

Simply laughable!

Regardless of whether Shen Yuan was happy or not, she directly rolled over to face away from Shen Yuan. "Mom has already bought you a lot of clothes. Now that it happens to be your father's campaign for county magistrate, the people in our family still need to keep a low profile to avoid giving people something to pick on."

Originally, upon hearing that her daughter only wanted a set of clothes, Shen Lan had wanted to let Si Rong take her to buy them directly tomorrow.

A girl should be raised with indulgence after all.

But as soon as he heard Si Rong considering things from his perspective everywhere, he agreed deeply.

At a time like this, it was indeed better to be cautious.

"Listen to your mom. Dad will definitely buy it for you after a while."

When the time came for him to become county magistrate and everything stabilized, his daughter would naturally be able to wear whatever she wanted.

Shen Yuan fell asleep unhappily.

"Wife, it's a good thing I have you."

Shen Lan's arm reached across their daughter and gently patted the back of Si Rong's hand.

The corners of Si Rong's mouth curved in mockery.

Yes!

Having her was Shen Lan's good fortune, but meeting Shen Lan was truly her bad luck for eight hundred lifetimes.

Fortunately, that phone call had warned her, otherwise she wouldn't have known how long she would be deceived.

Now that she knew in advance, she couldn't allow herself to be fooled ignorantly for so many years like that.

It turned out a person could deceive the person sleeping beside them with such a straight face.

She had learned.

"Husband, it's also a good thing I have you."

Her soft voice sounded tender in the quiet night, and Shen Lan felt thoroughly warmed inside as he heard it.

Yes, he thought.

Fortunately, they had each other.

"Every day you go to work and I'm so bored at home, I want to open a dance studio."

Si Rong said.

"You can go shopping with Mingzi, why suddenly think of opening a dance studio?"

Deep down, Shen Lan wasn't too keen on Si Rong going out; he hadn't been since they were young.

You must know that back in school, Si Rong was a campus-belle-level beauty. Being a man, he understood men's thoughts best, so he had never really liked Si Rong talking to other men.

Even though Si Rong was now approaching forty, she was still a beauty for her age.

"However, I've already made up my mind."

Si Rong said again.

In her life, she didn't want to depend on anyone else anymore.

In her early years, she was the daughter of the Si family; after marriage, she was Mrs. Shen.

But now, she wanted to be herself.

Perhaps because he rarely heard such a firm and resolute tone from Si Rong, Shen Lan fell silent for a long time.

He liked the gentle, submissive Si Rong.

He didn't like her having independent thoughts.

"Husband, you're going to keep moving up in the future, and I also hope I can help you later on."

Si Rong added another sentence.

So that was it; Shen Lan instantly felt at ease.

Si Rong loved him deeply; perhaps she felt uncomfortable thinking she always had to rely on her maiden family's money and influence to help him.

Since it was for his sake, Shen Lan agreed.

"Alright, feel free to use our savings."

He knew that Si Rong was a good woman who knew how to manage a household; even if she were allowed to use it, she wouldn't bear to spend recklessly.

The savings of over two hundred thousand weren't just his salary, but also the subsidies the Si family had given this only daughter over the years.

However, his wife was right. What he wanted to do wasn't just be a county magistrate; he wanted to go even higher.

With Si Rong going out to start a business, her two brothers and the two elders of the Si family would definitely assist, a sure win with no loss.

He emphasized once more, "Just one thing: you're not allowed to wear yourself out."

Listening to his utterly hypocritical concern, Si Rong only felt sick.

She forced herself to close her eyes.

She didn't know when she fell asleep, but she had a dream in which she heard that urgent telephone ringing again.

chapters.title: Do You Hate It?
chapters.content:
I am you from the future.

Shen Lan has betrayed you; he has deceived you so bitterly!

Do you hate it?

A moment later, the telephone cord seemed to twist into the shape of a human figure, holding a knife in its hand and walking toward her step by step.

Kill him! Kill him!

Si Rong woke up breathing heavily. Shen Lan was looking at her anxiously from the side. "Rongrong, what's wrong?"

"Nothing," Si Rong found that her back was covered in a layer of sweat.

Her pajamas were soaked through.

The dream was simply too real and too terrifying.

The murderous aura of her future self in the dream looked so scary.

Half a month later, she would know the results of the paternity test.

If Shen Yuan truly was Shen Lan's biological daughter, then Shen Lan's deception toward her had lasted for eighteen years.

This scheme had begun the moment they married.

"Did you have a nightmare?"

Shen Yuan should have already gotten up to go to school. Shen Lan wanted to pull her into his embrace from the side, a teasing expression on his face. "Tonight, let Xiaoyuan sleep on the very inside, and I'll hold you so you won't have nightmares anymore."

His approach made Si Rong feel nauseated.

Without a trace, she pushed him away. Si Rong got out of bed and put on her slippers. "Don't worry, don't let it delay your work, I'm going to take a shower."

After finishing her shower, Si Rong thought of another matter.

Now that Mrs. Shen and Shen Yun were living in their home, it would be better for her to take her jewelry and things back to her maiden family.

In the past, every time Shen Yun came, she would quietly take her jewelry, but out of consideration that she was Shen Lan's younger sister, she let her take them.

From now on, though, she needn't think about taking advantage of this anymore.

Si Rong packed all her jewelry into her handbag and took it back to her maiden family.

Today happened to be a day when both her older and second brothers were at home.

"Xiaorong is back?" Si Han ruffled her hair. "Second Brother brought back a very trendy set of denim overalls for you from the south."

"Thank you, Second Brother!"

Whenever there was anything good, they always thought of bringing it to her.

"Right, I ran into that girl Shen Yuan when I was out running earlier. She said she wanted to go to Aaron Kwok's concert and asked me to buy two tickets. Did she want to take you along? Second Brother will have someone buy them for you later!"

Si Rong felt a pang in her heart. "Second Brother, no need to buy them."

How could that girl have thought of taking her along? It was nothing more than wanting to show off in front of her classmates.

Si Han was somewhat surprised. He knew that ever since her infertility, his younger sister had treated these two adopted children as her own.

He had also thought about being better to those two kids so that they could show more filial piety and care for their younger sister in the future.

Her older brother, Si Yan, with his hands in his pockets, carefully observed his younger sister's expression. "Did that kid make you angry?"

He comforted her, "Kids these days at fifteen or sixteen are all like this; they'll be sensible when they grow up."

"Right, this period should be the critical moment for Shen Lan's campaign for county magistrate. Big Brother heard he has a very strong competitor. How is it? Does Big Brother need to step in?"

That formidable opponent seemed to have been transferred horizontally from the city.

Si Rong had also heard Shen Lan mention it a few times; it truly caused Shen Lan a great deal of annoyance.

"No need."

These words similarly shocked Si Yan, as well as Si Father and Si Mother standing aside.

The few of them looked at each other in dismay.

Si Rong looked apologetically at her parents and two brothers. "I might be getting a divorce."

Although this thought in her heart had long since solidified, Si Rong's current concern was the worry that her divorce would bring shame upon her family.

After all, society's malice toward women after divorce was still quite great, and a divorced woman seemed to carry an indecent reputation.

And the Si family was a prominent and respectable household.

"Is it Shen Lan? Did he do something to let you down?" Her second brother, Si Han, had a fiery temper and immediately rolled up his sleeves, ready to go find Shen Lan and settle accounts.

Si Rong nodded, reaching out to grab her second brother's arm. "Second Brother, he has someone else outside."

Saying these words in front of her family; Si Rong had originally thought she was psychologically prepared, but she still cried into a tearful mess.

It made her think of eighteen years ago when her ignorant self had held Shen Lan's hand just like this, standing before her family and swearing to them that she would definitely live a happy life with Shen Lan forever.

How utterly ridiculous!

"I'm going to go cripple him!" Si Han declared immediately, having already designed dozens of ways for Shen Lan to die in his mind.

"Wait for me to go together!" Although Si Yan looked scholarly, now that his younger sister had suffered such a grievance, he couldn't maintain his scholarly demeanor anymore.

He just wanted to beat Shen Lan to death!

"Xiaorong, get a divorce," Mrs. Mother held her daughter in her arms with a heartache. "Don't be afraid. Come back to our own home; live with Mom and Dad from now on."

Si Rong bit her lower lip tightly. "Mm. Big Brother, Second Brother, I can't divorce just yet."

"Why?" Si Father wished he could rush over to the Shen family right this instant.

Deputy county magistrate? Without their Si family, Shen Lan was nothing!

"Dad, Mom, Big Brother, Second Brother, there are still some things I haven't figured out yet. Once everything is clear, I will definitely get a divorce."

How could the members of the Si family not know her disposition?

"Xiaorong, if that piece of trash dares to bully you, let Second Brother know anytime," Si Han instructed.

"And Big Brother." Si Yan now also knew what he should do.

He didn't plan on going on any business trips during this period. Besides, that ungrateful wretch Shen Lan actually dared to betray his younger sister, so he could forget about the county magistrate election.

Not only that, for the sake of the Si family's future prosperity, he decided to switch his support to Shen Lan's competitor instead.

It was time to let Shen Lan know that without the Si family's backing, not only would he be unable to rise upward, but he would instead plummet to the very bottom.

"Keep my wanting a divorce a secret for now, especially in front of the Shen family."

It was precisely because she was worried her older brother might secretly help Shen Lan lobby for votes that Si Rong revealed her divorce.

The forcibly restrained tears at the corners of her mother's eyes and her father's stooped back both filled her with heartache.

Heartbroken that her parents were of such an advanced age and still had to worry over her.

Seeing that she had her own plan, the Si family parents felt somewhat more at ease.

Only then did Mrs. Mother understand what her daughter had meant earlier when asking her to help buy a house.

It was good that she knew how to plan for herself.

"We understand. The family welcomes you back at any time."

Meanwhile, on the other side, just after Si Rong left home, Shen Yun was plotting to go into her room to find some jewelry to save face.

Yet she worried that if Si Rong found out, she would be angry, after all, she and Yang Junwei's matter still required Si Rong to mediate in the middle.

"What of it?" When Mrs. Shen found out, she thought nothing of it. "What's the use of her wearing dazzling jewelry at her age? Besides, since she married into our Shen family, everything is our family's. Let's go! Mom will go with you to get it!"

Even though the Si family had some money, when all was said and done, their Shen family had gotten the raw end of the deal by marrying such an egg-laying-incapable hen like Si Rong.

What harm was there in her daughter wearing a few pieces of her jewelry?

Would she have the face to go around telling people?

Aunt Wang watched from the side with a hesitant expression.

As soon as that mother and daughter entered Si Rong's bedroom, she found the family phone directory and dialed the Si family's number.

chapters.title: Reporting to the Police
chapters.content:
"Ma'am, when are you coming back?"

Ma Wang didn't dare to speak too loudly, but since the madam usually treated her quite well, she didn't want that bandit-like mother and daughter messing with the madam's things.

"I'll be back this afternoon. Is something the matter?"

Si Rong guessed something. "Did Shen Yun go into my room?"

"Yes."

"Ma Wang, don't worry about it for now. Wait until I get back."

An idea suddenly crossed Si Rong's mind, and a smile tugged at the corner of her lips.

This Shen Yun, taking advantage of her time and time again; it was about time she spat some of it back out.

After eating at home, Si Rong returned to the Shen residence.

...

"Shen Lan, I'm so scared, please come back quickly!"

Shen Lan was working when he suddenly received a call from home.

Hearing the tearfulness in Si Rong's voice, his chest tightened instantly.

Although Si Rong was usually delicate and spoiled most of the time, she never disturbed his work for no reason.

"What's wrong?" Shen Lan picked up his coat, preparing to head home immediately.

"We have a burglar in the house!"

"Then protect yourself first, I'm coming right back!"

Shen Lan hung up the phone and hurried back home without stopping.

At home, Si Rong had already called the police, and officers were standing in the living room recording the items Si Rong reported missing.

"One gold thousand-thread bracelet, one white jade Guanyin, two jade imperial bracelets, and a mutton-fat jade necklace. Ms. Si, are there any others?"

Si Rong shook her head slightly. "I can't think of any others for now, just these."

Shen Lan stepped forward, half-embracing her, and looked her over. "Are you alright?"

Si Rong shook her head. "I'm fine, it's just that those pieces of jewelry were stolen. They were dowry items my maternal grandmother saved up for me in the past."

"As long as you're okay, those are just material possessions."

He vaguely felt those items sounded familiar, but couldn't remember where he had heard of them.

"Shen Lan, to me, those things aren't just jewelry, they're keepsakes."

The police officer reviewed the log. "Don't worry, Ms. Si, we will definitely help you get these items back."

For some reason, Shen Lan found it very grating to hear the police officer address Si Rong as "Ms. Si."

"Officer, my name is Shen Lan, I am the county magistrate of Huaiyang City, and this is my wife."

Although he was the deputy magistrate, Shen Lan always introduced himself as the magistrate.

Not only did it sound smoother, but more importantly, in just over a month, he would rightfully be the magistrate anyway.

The two junior police officers responding to such a petty case looked at each other, and one asked the other, "Isn't our magistrate surnamed Ma?"

Shen Lan: ......

He instantly felt he had lost face. "I am Deputy Magistrate Shen."

It took a great deal of effort for Si Rong to keep herself from scoffing out loud.

Shen Lan really knew how to gild his own lily, passing himself off as the magistrate at every turn.

Unfortunately, he didn't know that the position of magistrate was already something he would spend his life striving for in vain.

"Alright, Deputy Magistrate Shen, our station will definitely take this theft case very seriously..."

Just then, the Shen mother and daughter returned.

Seeing police officers in the house, Mother Shen was startled. "Good heavens, what is going on?"

"Mom, our house was broken into by a thief, and a lot of my things are missing. So I called the police to help us find them."

Mother Shen's heart skipped a beat.

Shen Yun was so frightened she instantly shrank behind Mother Shen.

What did Si Rong mean? Those things were just things she had borrowed to wear for a bit, why suddenly call the police?

And today she hadn't found any jewelry in Si Rong's bedroom at all, not even cash.

Mother Shen was so angered by Si Rong's move that her vision darkened slightly. "You're nearly forty years old, why are you still so unreasonable? If some minor things are lost, they're lost, why make the police officers run out here for this?"

Could she be doing it on purpose?

Mother Shen quickly dismissed the thought; Si Rong wasn't that petty, she probably thought the items were genuinely lost.

"Mom, you're wrong about that. Those aren't ordinary little pieces of jewelry; put together, they're worth over twenty thousand yuan!" Si Rong seemed somewhat displeased with her reaction. "You're my mother-in-law, why are you speaking up for a thief?"

Hearing her repeatedly call them a thief, Shen Yun didn't even dare to lift her head now.

Seeing this, how could Shen Lan not understand what was happening? However, Si Rong always understood the bigger picture, so he wanted to pull Si Rong aside and then find some excuse to retract the police report.

"What is it?" Si Rong asked, knowing full well.

"I'll buy you jewelry again later, let's send them away first!" Shen Lan said in a low voice.

Of course, Si Rong wasn't going to let it go so easily this time, so she pretended not to understand Shen Lan's hint. "Why? What about the thief who stole my things?"

Shen Lan frowned; Si Rong seemed somewhat disobedient today.

"Those pieces of jewelry... Xiaoyun probably took them to wear for fun," he could only patiently whisper in Si Rong's ear.

"What?!" Si Rong widened her eyes in absolute disbelief. "Xiaoyun stole those things?!"

Her voice was so loud that the faces of the Shen family members flushed crimson instantly.

Especially Shen Lan, who experienced an unprecedented sense of humiliation.

The sound of footsteps outside was probably a neighbor; perhaps within two days, these household matters would be known to everyone in the residential compound.

Si Rong was really something! Why make such a big deal out of meaningless gold and silver jewelry!

Shen Lan suddenly felt that Si Rong had become rather vulgar.

Shen Yun's face turned even paler. "I, I, Brother~"

She looked at Shen Lan for help.

But Si Rong had already lunged forward, grabbing her shoulders and shaking her back and forth frantically, "Xiaoyun, I treated you so well, and you actually stole my things?"

"What stealing?" Mother Shen hurriedly went to pull her off. "We're all family, how can you talk about your youngest sister like that?"

This was simply too much!

She wished she could rip apart this capitalist daughter-in-law's mouth!

Thinking that such a scolding would frighten Si Rong, she never expected Si Rong to simply slump to the ground.

"Sob sob, since when does killing someone count as not being murder just because you're family?"

Si Rong's words left the police officers momentarily stunned.

Even an honest official finds it hard to settle family quarrels, and the scene before them was giving them a headache.

"Well, you should just return what you took to your sister-in-law as soon as possible!"

One of the police officers advised.

"That's right! Those things have special significance to my sister-in-law," Si Rong didn't plan to completely burn bridges with her mother-in-law and sister-in-law just yet. "Xiaoyun, your sister-in-law doesn't want the police to arrest you either! That would make your sister-in-law very sad."

Shen Yun: ......

She stared at Si Rong with venomous eyes. Heh~

It served her brother right for having a home on the side, and it served Si Rong right for being led around by the nose; truly served her right!

If Li Xuan were her sister-in-law right now, she certainly wouldn't treat her like this.

---

chapters.title: She is Shen Lan's True Love
chapters.content:
However, no matter how aggrieved she felt right now, she had to endure it; she couldn't ruin her brother's big plans.

Besides, she hadn't married Yang Junwei yet.

Shen Yun could only grit her teeth and say, "As soon as I get home, I'll return everything to you!"

The police officers gave a few more instructions before leaving.

As soon as the door closed, Mother Shen wanted to assert her dominance as a mother-in-law.

With her hands on her hips, she snapped, "For someone from the Si family, you sure are a disgrace! Have you never heard that family scandals shouldn't be aired in public? How did your parents back home educate you?"

"Certainly not as well as you educated your youngest sister, educating her into a thief!" Si Rong rolled her eyes and shot right back.

"You, you!"

Mother Shen felt like she was about to die of anger.

She pointed at Shen Lan, who had remained silent throughout. "I raised you for nothing, just watching your mother and little sister get bullied!"

Shen Lan was indeed somewhat disappointed in Si Rong.

However, he always prioritized the bigger picture, so he scolded Shen Yun, "You are not allowed to touch your sister-in-law's things ever again!"

Crying, Shen Yun ran back to the guest room.

Starting from this day, Si Rong and Shen Lan entered a cold war.

This was Shen Lan's usual modus operandi.

In the past, Si Rong almost always compromised to patch things up between them, but this time, Si Rong wouldn't.

She had no time to consider Shen Lan's emotions; she was already busy preparing for her dance class.

Her initial plan was to recruit young girls over the age of ten.

She named the dance studio "Rong Zi."

The first order of business was renovation.

The three commercial storefronts she bought last time were finally coming in handy.

Si Rong decided to renovate the largest storefront and rent out the other two.

That phone call had told her that buying property was always a good idea, and if the dance class turned a profit later on, she would definitely continue buying real estate.

She didn't know much about house renovations, so she made a call to her second brother, Si Han.

Her second brother was in the building materials business now, and she had heard he also handled interior decoration.

"Want to open a dance studio?"

"Your second brother will handle the renovation! Tell him the address, and he'll have all the furniture you need delivered and fully equipped!"

Within a few sentences, the matter was settled by her second brother.

Next was advertising and publicity.

She remembered her eldest brother's foreign trade company did a lot of marketing, and even the bus stops were printed with his company's ads.

"Little sis, leave the advertising to your eldest brother, don't worry."

"Just sit back and wait to be a teacher!"

Ming Zi, standing nearby, clicked her tongue in amazement.

"As expected of our little princess Si Rong! I'm jealous, I really want to hit you!"

Cooperating, Si Rong held out her hand to her. "Here! Go ahead and hit!"

"Do you know what I envy about you the most?"

Ming Zi gave her a light pat on the hand.

"What?"

"It's not that Shen Lan is completely obedient to you, because he might love you just for being Si Rong, a Si of the Si family. What I envy most is the love you get from your father, mother, and brothers in the Si family, simply because you are Si Rong, the Si of Si Rong."

Ming Zi spoke with deep emotion.

How could she not be envious?

Back then, there was no one around Si Rong who didn't envy her.

Yet Li Xuan never spoke of this envy aloud, though the look of jealousy would still leak from the corners of her eyes and brows.

Otherwise, with so many men in the world, why on earth would she happen to fancy the exact same man as her good friend?

Completely forgetting how well Si Rong had treated the two of them back then.

"Let's go find Li Xuan!"

Ming Zi suggested.

She was genuinely curious: just how ungrateful and heartless must someone be to steal a man from her good friend?

Si Rong was equally curious. Anyway, with her two brothers helping out with the renovation and publicity, she had nothing to do, so she might as well go see Li Xuan.

Previously, the three of them mostly gathered at the Shen residence or Ming Zi's home.

Because Li Xuan claimed she had germaphobia.

Whenever guests came over, she would clean incessantly.

Oddly enough, that germaphobia seemed to clear right up when she was stealing her best friend's man.

When Li Xuan opened the door and saw the two of them, she was slightly startled, freezing in the doorway for a moment.

Why did these two suddenly show up?

Lately, Li Xuan often felt uneasy in her heart; last night she even dreamed that Si Rong caught her and Shen Lan in bed together!

She had been panicked the entire day.

She could only comfort herself that she was just overthinking, as they had hidden it so well; how could Si Rong possibly know?

She squeezed out a smile. "Why are you two here?"

"Don't you welcome us?" Ming Zi half-leaned forward to peer into her room. "Are you hiding a man in there?"

The smile on Li Xuan's face stiffened slightly, and she stepped aside to welcome them into the room.

"What nonsense are you talking about? Come in!"

This Ming Zi, ever since they first met, she had always spoken without a shred of politeness.

Even now, when she had become a respected dance teacher in Huaiyang County's colleges and won numerous awards, this Ming Zi still spoke to her like this!

Come to think of it, she at least made a living by her own abilities, making her far better than Ming Zi, a woman who got ahead by clinging to a rich second-generation heir.

"What nonsense? Do you dare say you don't have a man?"

Ming Zi's tongue was as sharp as a knife. "I even heard a friend say the other day that you were looking very intimate with some man! You're so uncool, are you keeping a boyfriend a secret from us?"

These words sent a chill down Li Xuan's spine; she didn't even dare to meet their eyes.

It felt as though she had something shameful to hide.

"No."

She busied herself making tea.

"It's normal if you do; after all, you're at this age. Just as long as you aren't out there being a mistress."

Li Xuan's hand slipped on the teacup, spilling scalding hot water over the back of her hand.

"Did you really become a mistress?"

Ming Zi felt she deserved it. If Si Rong hadn't wanted to avoid alerting the enemy just yet, she would have slapped Li Xuan right across the face.

"Enough!" Li Xuan slammed the teacup heavily onto the table. "Do you think you're so noble? What's so great about marriage? How many women did your husband find outside this year? Can you count them on one hand?"

"You!"

Seeing the two of them about to come to blows, Si Rong sighed. "If it's not true, then it's not true. Why get so angry and defensive?"

Her gaze landed on Li Xuan's wooden coffee table.

There was nothing particularly special about the coffee table; what caught Si Rong's eye was a brand-new telephone sitting on top of it.

"Li Xuan, you got a phone installed? How come you never mentioned it?"

So, this was the phone she used to seduce Shen Lan.

Li Xuan's eyes flashed with panic; even more panicked than when Ming Zi had insidiously called her a mistress just moments ago.

"I... I just got it installed recently too."

Ming Zi paced over to the telephone. "We're old classmates after all, don't you plan to give us the number?"

"I'll write it down for you."

Li Xuan opened a drawer, took out a sticky note, and wrote down a string of numbers.

Seeing the phone number, Si Rong found it frighteningly familiar; it was indeed the exact number Shen Lan dialed every time he went on a business trip.

Now that all the facts were laid out before her, Si Rong felt she could barely mask the expression on her face.

"I suddenly remembered I have some things to take care of, so I'll leave first."

Not wanting them to stay any longer either, Li Xuan hurriedly ushered them out with unsteady steps. "Alright, then come over to hang out again when you have time."

Once the door was closed, Li Xuan slowly squatted down on the floor as if drained of all strength, hugging her own shoulders.

Tears soaked the soft fabric of her clothes.

What was that look Si Rong gave her just now?

Does she know that I am her husband's true love?

Shen Lan belongs to her.

She should be the county magistrate's wife!

Panicking, Li Xuan stood up, determined to call Shen Lan. Why should she have to live life hiding in the shadows like this?

She wanted to live in the light too!
